Loop tuning

Northwind Studio tunes a loop from a step response it records itself. The procedure below applies to any single-input single-output loop on an NX-series controller running firmware 4.2 or later.

Before you start

  • Put the loop in manual and let the process settle.
  • Confirm the output limits are the ones the plant expects, not the factory defaults.
  • Record the current gains, so the loop can be returned to its previous behaviour.

Running an autotune

  1. Select the loop in the project tree and open the Tuning tab.
  2. Choose a step size that the process can absorb without tripping an alarm.
  3. Start the test and leave the loop alone until Studio reports a completed response.
  4. Accept the proposed gains, or copy them into the manual fields and adjust.

Parameters

ParameterRangeDefault
Proportional band0.1 – 500 %100 %
Integral time1 – 3600 s120 s
Derivative time0 – 900 s0 s

Scripting the same test

loop = studio.loop("FIC-201")
loop.autotune(step=2.5, timeout=600)
loop.commit()

The scripting interface reports the same completion codes as the interactive test, so a batch of loops can be tuned from one script and reviewed afterwards.
